# Third-party libraries

These files are copied unchanged from their npm packages so the app works without a CDN and can load offline.

| Library | Version | Use | License |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| [jsQR](https://github.com/cozmo/jsQR) | 1.4.0 | Reads QR codes from the camera and from photos | Apache-2.0 (`jsqr/LICENSE`) |
| [Leaflet](https://leafletjs.com) | 1.9.4 | Maps for pin drops and hotspots | BSD-2-Clause (`leaflet/LICENSE`) |
| [qrcode-generator](https://github.com/kazuhikoarase/qrcode-generator) | 1.4.4 | Draws the QR codes on the test packs page | MIT (header of `qrcode-generator/qrcode.js`) |
